scope: Only the new MultiHot40 v2 adapter. Full presentation, browser integration and release decisions belong to the parent continuation.

diagnosis.cause: The original disabled draft used uniform independent symbols and a uniform 1x–5x wheel after restoring unscaled public prizes. That distribution returns 76.72119140625%, so it does not satisfy the intended native 94–97% profile.

method.lineAggregation: Every path contains one independent symbol from each of the five reels. Each path therefore has the same marginal expectation. Linearity of expectation applies despite correlations between different winning lines; 40 paths and the stake/40 award basis cancel.
method.money: All 18 supported stakes are multiples of 40 santim; every public coefficient is an integer. Line prizes and total wins are integral, so there is no rounding draw or rounding loss.

maximum.proof: Each line pays at most 500 times its line stake and the wheel multiplies by at most 5; 40 lines imply a total no greater than 2500 times total stake. All 20 sevens with 5x attain this bound.

method.randomness: The existing canonical service supplies a secret-seed HMAC stream of uniform 53-bit fractions. Symbol, wheel and suit selections use 8, 16 and 4 equiprobable buckets, all exact divisors of 2^53.

collection.manual: Positive win remains active and reserved until collection or expiry; the next Spin must collect then start.
collection.autoplay: Explicit autoCollect:true settles in the original paid transaction.
collection.expiryBehavior: Collect the full current win without a fresh random draw; service reconciliation works after account blocking and new-start disabling.

gamble.limitMeaning: The independent ETB profile permits gambling a current win of at most 500.00 ETB. A successful attempt doubles it without clipping; a win above 500.00 ETB can only be collected. The reference source contains the number 500, but its exact pre/post-double boundary remains unverified.
gamble.expectedReturn: Fair independent red/black choices preserve the expected slot payout for any strategy bounded by the five-attempt and eligibility limits; collection and disconnection expiry return the full remaining amount.

verification.database: PGlite in-memory PostgreSQL, exact unchanged canonical wallet, no service database connection
coverage: single debit and conserved double-entry ledger
accepted collection after disabled starts/lower account cap
atomic rollback for insufficient funds/bankroll/account cap
collect before next Spin and navigation cancellation
autoplay automatic collection and stopping limits
account changes and stale history responses
accepted win collection despite artwork failure
verification.limitation: One embedded PostgreSQL connection, plus a VM control harness with real session/controller code and fixture DOM/network/rendering; these do not replace browser or multi-process production checks. No production account, credit or wager was created.

remaining: Complete per-game player presentation and controls
The reference 500 doubling pre/post boundary remains unverified; the independent ETB rule is disclosed
